author: NASA
description:
NASA astronauts Anil Menon, Luke Delaney, Jessica Watkins and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Josh Kutryk share reflections, well wishes, and meal plans for Thanksgiving while living and working aboard the International Space Station as part of Expedition 75.
 
For more than 26 years, people have lived and worked continuously aboard the International Space Station, advancing scientific knowledge and making research breakthroughs not possible on Earth.
 
Get regular updates from the space station: https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/

Download this video: https://go.nasa.gov/4jxMLp9
title: 2026 Thanksgiving Message from the International Space Station

author: NASA
description:
What mysteries await on Europa?

This moon of Jupiter has long been thought to potentially hold life beneath its icy surface. A new mission, Europa Clipper, is on its way to look for answers — but getting it there has required relentless innovation and overcoming extraordinary challenges.

The Europa Concept is coming to YouTube in December. Watch it now on NASA+: https://plus.nasa.gov/video/the-europa-concept/ 
Learn more about this documentary: https://nasa.gov/europaconcept
title: The Europa Concept (Official NASA+ Trailer)
